summary: Frontend-only iteration 43 verification of new ClubhouseFeedComposer + submitPost adapter in ClubhouseTab. Live-app verification against preview URL using a fresh Firebase director account (TEST_i51_3964d5c6cc@example.com). All composer landmarks + all data-testids present, submit is disabled while empty, text-only post works end-to-end, image + video attachments each round-trip through /api/files/upload → /api/leagues/{id}/feed with correct {body,image_path,video_path} payloads, multi-attach (2 img + 1 vid) correctly renders 3 thumbnails and the adapter forwards ONLY the FIRST image + FIRST video (backend contract preserved). Moderation buttons still present, default landing still Clubhouse, ?tab=rounds still lands on Rounds. Oversize guard LOGIC works (Error 'image too large' / 'video too large' thrown, upload never attempted, queued files preserved), BUT the visible sonner toast never rendered because <Toaster /> is not mounted anywhere in the app tree — this is a pre-existing app-wide bug that also affects previous iterations' 'success' toasts; the composer implementation itself is correct.

ui_bugs.issue: <Toaster /> from sonner is imported/defined in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx but never mounted anywhere in App.jsx or main.jsx. Runtime check: document.querySelector('[data-sonner-toaster]') returns null on /leagues/{id}. Consequently every toast.error(...) / toast.success(...) across the entire app is a no-op visually. The oversize-image + oversize-video guards in ClubhouseTab.submitPost correctly throw ('image too large' / 'video too large' visible in console.error) and correctly preserve the queued files in the composer, but the user never sees the 'Image too large (max 8MB)' / 'Video too large (max 25MB)' toast.

action_items: Mount <Toaster /> (from '@/components/ui/sonner' or 'sonner') once at the root of App.jsx (typically just inside <Router>) so toast.success/toast.error render globally. Without this, the oversize-guard UX from the composer — and every toast fired by ClubhouseTab (delete post, mute user, story upload, etc.) — is invisible.
critical_code_review_comments: ClubhouseFeedComposer.jsx line 33 uses String.prototype.substr which is deprecated. Prefer substring(2, 11) or crypto.randomUUID(). Not blocking.

ClubhouseFeedComposer.jsx URL.createObjectURL previews are only revoked on removeAttachment. If the composer unmounts (or after successful submit that resets attachedFiles via setAttachedFiles([])), the blob URLs for the attached files leak because revokeObjectURL is not called in that path. Add a URL.revokeObjectURL loop after successful onPostSubmit and in a useEffect cleanup for the attachedFiles list.

ClubhouseTab.submitPost silently drops any 2nd+ image / 2nd+ video that the user queued. Code comment says this is intentional (backend accepts single image_path + video_path), but there is no user-facing hint (e.g., 'Only 1 image + 1 video will be attached'). Consider a subtle inline warning in the composer or a toast on submit when media.length > 2 to avoid user surprise.

ClubhouseTab.uploadOne throws on network failure but the composer's catch swallows the error into console.error only. Combined with the missing <Toaster />, users get zero feedback on a failed feed submit. Fixing the Toaster mount will address this.
App.jsx — <Toaster /> is missing at the app root (see ui_bugs above). This is the highest-impact finding.

success_rate.frontend: 8/9 request-list items fully verified; oversize-guard is 1/2 (logic ✅, toast text ❌ due to missing Toaster mount — pre-existing bug, not caused by this iteration)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Composer wiring is solid — all 6 data-testids resolve, adapter correctly maps {text, media[]} → {body, image_path, video_path} with first-of-kind semantics. When re-verifying, use REAL binary fixtures (PIL for JPGs, ffmpeg color-lavfi for MP4s) because Cloudinary rejects random-byte .mp4 blobs with 500 and that noise looks like a composer bug. Also: React's file input dedupes identical files by name+contents, so if you clear then re-add the same physical file via set_input_files, the second onChange does NOT fire — use two DIFFERENT files across sequential steps. Captured FEED POST bodies proving spec: text-only={body:'E2E test note',image_path:null,video_path:null}; image-only={body:'img-e2e',image_path:'acechasers/uploads/.../uuid.jpg',video_path:null}; video-only={body:'vid-e2e',image_path:null,video_path:'acechasers/uploads/.../uuid.mp4'}; multi 2img+1vid={body:'multi-e2e',image_path:<pic_b>,video_path:<tiny>} — pic_c dropped as expected. The <Toaster /> mount is the ONE thing main-agent must add; after that a single retest of the oversize-guard toast text is enough.
rca of the issue: Missing global <Toaster /> mount. Root cause: the sonner Toaster wrapper is defined in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx (default shadcn export pattern) but was never imported+rendered in App.jsx / main.jsx. `grep -rn '<Toaster' /app/frontend/src` returns zero matches. Reproduction: navigate to any /leagues/{id}, open devtools, run `!!document.querySelector('[data-sonner-toaster]')` → false. Mitigation: in /app/frontend/src/App.jsx, `import { Toaster } from '@/components/ui/sonner'` and render `<Toaster richColors position='top-right' />` once, adjacent to <Navigation /> inside <Router>. This restores visible feedback for the composer's oversize guards and for every existing toast.error/toast.success call across the app (delete post, mute user, story upload, announcement post, LF post, resolve, etc.).
